cases.name: merge_intervals
cases.prompt: Write a Python function merge_intervals(intervals). Input is a list of [start, end] integer pairs with start <= end, in any order. Return a list of merged [start, end] pairs sorted by start. Overlapping intervals and intervals that touch at an endpoint must be merged. Do not mutate the input. Return only Python code in a fenced code block.

cases.name: balanced
cases.prompt: Write a Python function balanced(s) that returns True if all brackets (), [] and {} in string s are properly nested and matched, otherwise False. Ignore all other characters. Return only Python code in a fenced code block.

cases.name: find_subsequence
cases.prompt: Write a Python function find_subsequence(haystack, needle) that returns the index of the first occurrence of the string needle in the string haystack, or -1 when absent. The empty needle occurs at index 0. Return only Python code in a fenced code block.

cases.name: run_length
cases.prompt: Write a Python function run_length(s) that returns a list of [character, count] pairs for each consecutive run in string s, in order. For example, aaabbc becomes [["a", 3], ["b", 2], ["c", 1]]. The empty string returns an empty list. Return only Python code in a fenced code block.
